edits.before: «Sigo pensando que la residencia actual no es segura. Pero no debí obligarte a aceptar retirándote la información y las contraseñas. Restableceré el acceso y después basaremos la evaluación de seguridad en registros compartidos y opiniones profesionales externas».
edits.after: «Sigo pensando que las condiciones actuales de vivienda no son seguras. Pero no debo forzarte a aceptar privándote de información y contraseñas. Restableceré el acceso a la información que corresponda, respetando la voluntad y la privacidad de la persona mayor y tras aclarar qué participación corresponde legítimamente a cada cual. Después basaremos la evaluación de seguridad en registros compartidos y opiniones profesionales externas».
edits.reason: Synchronizes root-approved follow-through of08p43: restore only due information access subject to elder's wishes/privacy and legitimate participation; no unconditional access promise. Keeps safety disagreement, noncoercion and later shared records/external professional advice. Root owns EN54.

edits.after: The apology itself can also change how the original conflict can be handled. Not because it decides who is right, but because acknowledging a violation restores some trust. Someone whose character was attacked may become willing to propose a new arrangement only once that attack is withdrawn. The person who spoke harshly no longer needs to make their original position increasingly absolute to defend their self-image. Separating the accounts of harm and conflict does not mean they have no effect on each other. It means settling one cannot be passed off as settling the other.
edits.reason: Naturalizes character negation and impersonating completion of another account without losing repair's effects on the conflict.
edits.before: The apology itself can also change how the original conflict can be handled. Not because it decides who is right, but because acknowledging a violation restores some trust. Someone whose character was negated may become willing to propose a new arrangement only once that negation is withdrawn. The person who spoke harshly no longer needs to make their original position increasingly absolute to defend their self-image. Separating the accounts of harm and conflict does not mean they have no effect on each other. It means neither can impersonate the completion of the other.

edits.after: 'I still think this money shouldn't be spent this way. But I should not have shared with other people the private information you had told me.'
edits.reason: Repairs modifier ambiguity: disclosure was public, not the original private confidence.
edits.before: 'I still think this money shouldn't be spent this way. But I should not have disclosed private information you told me in front of others.'

edits.after: Estas medidas deben empezar por respetar la voluntad y la privacidad de la persona mayor y aclarar qué participación corresponde legítimamente a cada cual. Dentro de esos límites, deben restablecerse las vías necesarias para acceder a la información, utilizar recursos y participar en las decisiones, o confiarse a un procedimiento más fiable, en vez de tratar la vida de esa persona como algo que solo han de repartirse sus familiares.
edits.reason: Full root source synchronization: elder's agency/privacy and legitimate participation precede restored information access, resource use and decision participation; no unconditional password sharing or family-only decision.
edits.before: Cuando haga falta, deben restablecerse los recursos y las vías de decisión o confiarse a un procedimiento más fiable.

edits.after: If one person controls the money, information, the other's body and safety, their social contacts, and the way out, the other's 'agreement' is difficult to interpret solely from the words spoken.
edits.reason: Clarifies whose bodily autonomy and contacts are controlled, instead of the impersonal plural bodies.
edits.before: If one controls money, information, bodies, safety, social contact, and the way out, the other's 'agreement' is difficult to interpret solely from the words spoken.

edits.after: Someone can establish intense control with good intentions and still needs to ask: does the other person have the basic means to act without first obtaining my approval?
edits.reason: Naturalizes basic conditions they can use; retains good intentions do not restore independent practical capacity.
edits.before: Someone can establish intense control with good intentions and still need to see whether the other has basic conditions they can use without that person's approval.

edits.after: Alguien puede establecer un control muy fuerte con buenas intenciones y aun así necesita preguntarse: ¿dispone la otra persona de medios básicos para actuar sin tener que obtener primero mi autorización?
edits.reason: Naturalizes disponer de condiciones que utilizar while retaining independently available basic means.
edits.before: Alguien puede establecer un control muy fuerte con buenas intenciones y aun así necesita reconocer si la otra parte dispone de condiciones básicas que pueda utilizar sin su autorización.

edits.after: It means first protecting the person—and their ability to face what remains.
edits.reason: Clarifies dangling them at the closing sentence; preserves protecting the person as condition for facing unresolved issue.
edits.before: It is first preserving the person who can still face them.

edits.after: Es proteger primero a la persona, para que siga pudiendo afrontar lo que queda por resolver.
edits.reason: Naturalizes conservar a alguien while retaining the person and continued ability to face the issue.
edits.before: Es conservar primero a alguien que todavía pueda afrontarlo.
